searchLimits: Local filename and metadata searches covered public, art-source, docs, production, workspace/tmp filename leads and pinned prior source audits. Unreadable /tmp/codex-daemon-1000 private directory was not searched.

No new independent original-work screenshot/render/model was located among inspected target leads. Additional V44 filename leads are retained as unverified illustrations, never accepted from filenames.
Current network remains unchanged; denied NECA CDN and other known denied hosts were not retried; no rewrites, alternate API routes or bypass.
No new image canvases or contact sheets were written; all images viewed directly from existing files.
conclusion: No newly qualified local canonical exact mask reference. Existing costume artwork may support clearly labeled project-design studies, but cannot fulfill an exact existing version by name. The inspected source pixels, identity limits and next missing dependencies are pinned for the parent to combine with separately acquired official photos.
